name: wsm
fix_description: In fetchPrice, uses AMM spot price which can be manipulated via flash loan. Fix: use TWAP oracle or Chainlink price feed.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a short but protocol-specific price manipulation using a Uniswap V3 flash loan, a swap to distort the WBNB/WSM price, and then abusing presale pricing via buyWithBNB() before unwinding and repaying. It is only a few steps and not deeply complex, but it requires understanding flash-loan-driven price skew and how the vulnerable presale contract derives token amounts from manipulated pool state.
